title: Concept: Temporary password returned in a response
description: A freshly generated temporary password in the response body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The temporary password is the whole credential for the first login, so returning it to the caller lets whoever requested the reset take the account.
applicability: Deployments that render a freshly generated temporary password in the response body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The temporary password is the whole credential for the first login, so returning it to the caller lets whoever requested the reset take the account.
